final:
fact(n: int) -> bigint =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= bigint(1)
  ex fact(0) == bigint(1)
  ex fact(5) == bigint(120)
  ex fact(20) == bigint(2432902008176640000)
  var acc = bigint(1)
  for i in range(1, n + 1)
    acc = acc * bigint(i)
  acc
